definitions.ask: Should `s` (select Summary) also leave the keymap footer in place instead of showing its explainer?
definitions.why: The report is about j/k; `s` is a documented hint that the next move now clears

choices.label: `s` keeps its 'Summary selected…' line until the next key; j/k then restores the keys
`s` keeps the keymap footer like other moves; ownership still shows inside the Summary stage
